purpose: Check whether a genuinely action-consequential delayed, context-dependent synthetic public source is both information-identifiable and genuinely goal-achievable before any native learner or held original FKP-17 first use.

predecessor.FKP17: research-only eight-arm fully qualified baseline and strong conventional controls, original private held unopened
predecessor.FKP18: public delayed-credit compositional candidate tied strong symbolic control exactly, no scientific advantage
predecessor.FKP07: known composition earned historical relation transfer but tied Bayes and active probing did not beat random

scope.source: new openly auditable synthetic PUBLIC source, not independent protected first-use evaluator
scope.worlds: 32 fixed diagnostic worlds, indices 0..31, exactly 4 causal operator families times 8 shift values; no post-result selecting worlds
scope.randomization: SHA-256 domain-separated deterministic per-world context and public exploration tape; all hypotheses replay same seed/tape
scope.initial_information: 8 public uint4 state registers before and after each action, 8 public actions, bounded 16 prior PUBLIC transitions, earned reward and done
scope.hidden_to_learner: law operator-family identity, shift parameter and alternative action outcomes; never provided to candidate/predictor
scope.temporal: feedback at step t is consequence of source action at t-2, conditioned on predecessor action(s) and publicly observed context when t-2 occurred; first 3 transitions after each terminal reset have no scored delayed feedback
scope.goal: three consecutive positive delayed consequences in one episode gives public earned reward +1.0 and done=true; positive nonterminal +0.25, incorrect -0.25, warmup 0; source continues with a newly reset episode on next action
scope.action_budget: 24 common public exploration steps then 16 individually on-policy scored action opportunities; actual positive and negative rewards counted, not hindsight oracle labels
scope.protected_exclusions: never instantiate FKP-17 DEV 978500..978531, TRANSFER 978600..978663, FKP-16 consumed source or any owner private evaluator

frozen_checks.uniqueness_after_24: at least 24 of 32 worlds have exactly one compatible full (family,shift) hypothesis under the same 24 public actions, using only observable before/after/reward/done
frozen_checks.ambiguity_after_8: at least 16 of 32 worlds retain two or more compatible source hypotheses after 8 public interventions, ruling out a trivially solved fixture
frozen_checks.oracle_goal_worlds: oracle receives private law for source-headroom upper reference and must achieve >=24/32 scored worlds with >=1 actual public done event
frozen_checks.random_goal_worlds: source-blind random actions achieve goals in <=4/32 scored worlds
frozen_checks.reward_headroom: mean actual earned 16-step reward oracle minus random >=2.0
frozen_checks.feedback: public train tape includes both positive and negative earned action consequences
frozen_checks.no_leakage: source hidden parameters, candidate counterfactuals and future rewards never occur in public transition fields, observation order and continuity preserved
frozen_checks.finish: classify SOURCE_FEASIBLE only if all predeclared checks pass, otherwise SOURCE_UNFIT/INVALID. Preserve negatives; do not tune after observing outcomes.

policy.future: For a true unfamiliar-law native improvement, use a separate owner-controlled disjoint law source and match to competent exact symbolic, recurrent, and pretraining baselines with reproducible source/action/compute receipts.
